predecessors.name: United Kingdom
predecessors.text: the island of Cyprus without the two British Sovereign Base Areas

ledger.x: 1960: Cyprus becomes independent from Britain on 16 August.
1974: the Turkish army lands at Kyrenia on 20 July, five days after the Greek junta's coup against Makarios (15 July).
1974: fighting ends in August with Turkey holding the north.
1974: Turkey holds the northern 36 % of the island.

wars.name: Turkish invasion of Cyprus
wars.outcome: Turkish victory (infobox, 20 July - 18 August 1974): Turkey captured 3 % of the island by the first ceasefire of 22 July and "approximately 36%" after the second offensive of 14 August; the Greek and Cypriot juntas collapsed on 23 and 24 July.

certainty.note: The coast is the frontier; the two Sovereign Base Areas are surveyed enclaves of the 1960 treaties.
The southern limit of the Turkish-held north is the 1974 ceasefire line, now the UN Buffer Zone (a line, not an agreed frontier).
